title: Decide how levels are assigned or changed, and who may change them

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Decided (Dylan, 2026-10-26): knowledge is atomic. A record like 'understands GNNs' is too coarse to gate on. Fields (GNNs) are tags, not leveled concepts. Brainstorm context: levels exist to gate experiment design; each design marks concepts load-bearing / operational / incidental with a required level; a gap is resolved by learn / substitute / accept-gap (an override never changes a level); Claude explaining is not evidence; note records the source (self-report vs explained back). Still open: atom definition, lazy creation, what to do with the existing graph-neural-networks record.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Decided (Dylan, 2026-10-26): concept structure is automatic. Claude creates concepts without user approval; consistency comes from written creation tests + a reference example (MSM/TPT tree) in SPEC, kt validation (proposed required summary field, part-of back), and an after-the-fact audit. A concept is a self-contained black box with a level on its outside; inner parts are their own concepts linked part-of; requires = real prerequisite. Friction belongs on the user's understanding (levels/gate), not on bookkeeping.
